title: Harlem Artist Ryan Dudley Drops New Single Baller
htmlContent:
Ryan Dudley was born and raised in Harlem, New York; he comes from a large family with eight brothers and sisters, five brothers and sisters, including him and two sisters. Growing up, Dudley was inspired by The Temptation, The Five Beats of Heart, Michael Jackson, Usher, B2K, and New Edition. Watching those icons entertain their audiences gave Dudley the confidence to chase his own dreams as an entertainer.

Dudley recently dropped his latest single, Baller, the follow-up single to his two music videos Chevy featuring QTG racked up 71k views on YouTube, and Sayless generated 18k views on YouTube. Baller is a song that I like and one that I would keep in rotation.

The song reminds me of something that Chris Brown would drop and it makes sense he is one of the artists that inspired Dudley. A collaboration that I would like to see somewhere down the line. Make sure, to check out Baller from Ryan Dudley and you find all his music on Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube moving forward.
